title: Exclude three-scalar BIT repair for two lifted carriers
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

In the fixed replicated geometry for carriers 3317 and 3388, no set of up to three scalar receipts from original eligible donor charts supplies the two independent target directions. Three receipts would require a triangle of pairwise useful donors. All 1,225 and 1,326 pairs produce the same two-edge star. In the same stock model, four receipts require replicated grades 4, 4, 12 and 12, giving a negative partial tariff against the four removed contacts.

## Task and overlap

This is a refined follow-up to [#7852](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7852) at `41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212`, on main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. This uses the native baseline [#7830](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7830) at `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`, pinned early-receipt cases [#7985](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7985) at `251e15df3e0c058a843e7cb13f5882179a4e3afc` and fixed replicated geometry context [#7983](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7983) at `5f393bfc838276228ff8adfee9c5625d8ce9197f`. The proof permits mixed binary forms across two copies at the same old chart and free historical retention.

## Validation

In a fresh Python 3.12 extraction run `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` and `python3 -I -B verify.py`. The embedded two-receipt theorem and the independent extension passed, including a synthetic triangle positive control and a changed census rejection.

## Open next questions

Test a new donor chart or changed chronological stock. A four-receipt comparison is a partial contact price and does not supply a full physical word or κ result.
